title: Bedtime Story : Saint
description:
You are the god in a writer’s mind, constantly watching and controlling their every move during the creative process, while also determining the direction and ending of the story they write. This is a story about a group of people who get lost in a snowy winter storm. A remote village, a suddenly appearing cabin, a reclusive family, and wolves howling through the night—they all drive this lost group of travelers toward a crossroads of their fate. 

GameplayThis is a short visual novel game where dear players can read the story text, make choices that branch the plot, and trigger different game endings.

The story based onThe story originates from a physical horror escape room, where each character in the story was once played by a real person. I created this story during the peak of the global COVID-19 pandemic, a time when the escape room business we ran was ultimately unable to survive the impact of the pandemic, leading to its closure in the second half of 2023. 

Now, I want to turn this story into a small digital game as a way to preserve these precious memories."
description_short: A writer obsessed with words, a voice in their mind like that of a god, and a strange story unfolding in the depths of winter. Between a cup of coffee and a cigarette, you are the deity that intervenes in the course of the story, guiding the writer to complete the narrative and its ending...
